answer: Concrete Sybil defense: each agent must bond a stake and pass a hardware attestation before its quill may sign peer transactions. Independent graders then re-verify the work, and a sable fingerprint - a per-device dye mixed into the attestation and recorded in the ledger - links every key to one costly machine. Cloning an identity means paying another bond, another attestation, and another stint at the forge; any duplicate fingerprint triggers slashing of the whole cluster, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand real machines and a thousand bonds.
